bio.title: About Pranshu
bio.content:
I'm a passionate software engineer and AI enthusiast specializing in full-stack development, machine learning, and innovative problem-solving. My expertise spans modern web technologies like React, Next.js, and TypeScript, combined with deep knowledge in artificial intelligence, LLMs, and scalable system architecture.

I focus on building impactful technology solutions—from IoT-powered smart city systems to AI-driven educational platforms and developer productivity tools. What drives me is the intersection of cutting-edge technology and real-world impact, creating solutions that enhance human experiences and solve meaningful problems.

I thrive on tackling complex challenges that require both technical depth and creative innovation, always staying at the forefront of emerging technologies like Generative AI, LSTM networks, and cloud-based architectures.

philosophy.title: Development Philosophy
philosophy.content:
I craft technology that transforms ideas into meaningful solutions. Every line of code I write starts with a fundamental question: "How will this create real value and solve actual problems people face?"

My development approach centers on action and impact:

**🎯 Solve Real Problems**: I dive deep into user challenges, building solutions that address genuine pain points rather than just adding features for the sake of features.

**🚀 Build for Scale**: I architect systems that evolve with growth, anticipating future needs while delivering immediate value today.

**⚡ Ship Fast, Learn Faster**: I embrace rapid iteration, gathering feedback early and often to refine solutions based on real-world usage patterns.

**🤝 Share Knowledge**: I actively contribute to the developer community through open-source projects, mentoring, and knowledge sharing because great ideas flourish when shared.

**🔧 Engineer for Tomorrow**: I write clean, maintainable code that future developers (including myself) will thank me for, prioritizing long-term sustainability over quick fixes.

I'm driven by the transformative potential of AI in everyday applications. Rather than replacing human creativity, I leverage artificial intelligence to amplify human capabilities and unlock new possibilities. This vision shapes everything I build—from smart city infrastructure that makes urban life more efficient, to educational platforms that personalize learning experiences, to developer tools that eliminate repetitive tasks and unlock creative potential.

Technology should feel invisible when it works perfectly. That's the standard I code toward.

contact.title: Let's Connect
contact.content:
I'm always excited to discuss new opportunities, collaborate on interesting projects, or simply connect with fellow developers and technologists. Whether you're interested in AI applications, full-stack development, or innovative problem-solving, I'd love to hear from you.
Feel free to reach out if you're looking for someone who can bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and practical applications, or if you want to discuss how AI and modern web technologies can solve complex challenges in your organization.

projects.title: ThinkForge – AI-Powered Historical Debate Simulator
projects.description: An educational platform that brings historical thinkers like Socrates, Nietzsche, and Confucius to life through AI-powered debate simulations. Uses a dual-phase pipeline: Perplexity Sonar API for real-time research and LLMs for authentic personality simulation. Features 20+ historical figures engaging in multi-round debates on modern topics, maintaining character consistency and philosophical accuracy. Includes interactive UI with debate transcripts, thinker profiles, and real-time responses. Makes philosophy accessible through dynamic conversations that apply historical wisdom to contemporary issues.
features: Historical personalities: Socrates, Nietzsche, Confucius, and more
Real-time research integration via Perplexity Sonar API
Dynamic topic matchups and debate scenarios
Interactive UI with live debate transcripts

challenges: Maintaining historical accuracy and personality consistency
Handling real-time API limitations and response delays
Designing multi-layered prompt construction for authentic responses
Balancing educational depth with entertainment value
Creating seamless user experience with async operations
Ensuring debate continuity across multiple rounds
learnings: Advanced prompt engineering techniques for personality simulation
Experience with real-time API integration and queue management
Deep understanding of historical philosophical perspectives
Skills in async queue systems and performance optimization
Knowledge of educational platform design principles

projects.technicalDetails: ThinkForge uses a dual-phase pipeline: Context Extraction via Perplexity Sonar API for fact-gathering, and Personality Simulation using carefully tuned prompts for character-authentic responses. The system maintains conversation context across multiple rounds while ensuring historical accuracy and philosophical consistency. Future enhancements include voice synthesis, mobile app, multilingual support, and gamified learning modules.

projects.title: GitHub Repository Documentation Generator
projects.description: An AI-powered web application that automatically generates comprehensive README files and project documentation for GitHub repositories. Users connect via GitHub OAuth to fetch repositories, and the AI analyzes code structure, comments, and files using LLMs and LangChain. Features multiple writing styles (professional, beginner-friendly, minimal, detailed), real-time chat assistant, editable outputs, and export functionality. Streamlines documentation workflow by creating well-structured README files with installation guides, usage examples, and API docs.
features: GitHub OAuth integration for repository access
Multiple tone/style options (professional, beginner-friendly, minimal, detailed)

challenges: Implementing OAuth flow securely with GitHub API
Training AI models to understand code context
Optimizing AI response time for large repositories
learnings: Deep understanding of GitHub API integration
Experience with LangChain for AI pipeline development
Skills in natural language processing and generation

projects.technicalDetails: Built with Next.js frontend and Node.js backend, integrating GitHub OAuth for secure repository access. Uses LangChain to orchestrate LLM interactions, analyzing repository structure, code comments, and existing documentation to generate contextually relevant README files with customizable styles and tones.

projects.title: Smart Street Light Management System
projects.description: A smart system that transforms traditional street lights into intelligent monitoring devices using AI and IoT sensors. The retrofit device monitors bulb health, analyzes vibration patterns, and uses LSTM + GenAI for weather-based control. Features dual portals - Admin Panel for city-wide monitoring and Technician Portal with QR-based deployment. Provides real-time fault detection, predictive maintenance alerts, and cost-efficient smart city infrastructure upgrades without replacing existing lights.
features: Weather-based intelligent control using LSTM + GenAI
Real-time fault detection (wire breaks, bulb failures)

images.caption: Smart Street Light System Overview
images.alt: Smart Street Light Management System Interface

challenges: Integrating AI predictions with real-time sensor data
Creating user-friendly interfaces for different user types
Optimizing power consumption for retrofit devices
learnings: Deep understanding of LSTM networks for time-series prediction
Experience with IoT sensor integration and embedded programming
Knowledge of weather API integration and forecasting
Skills in developing dual-portal systems with different access levels

projects.technicalDetails: The system uses LSTM neural networks combined with Generative AI to predict optimal lighting schedules based on weather patterns. IR sensors monitor bulb status, vibration sensors detect physical tampering, and current sensors track electrical health. The retrofit design allows easy installation on existing infrastructure without major modifications.
